entry.title: New: dsh-plugin-mall
entry.summary: Open plugin marketplace: live GitHub dsh-plugin topic search with per-repo package.json verification (dsh.bundle/dsh.client manifest badges and a verified-only filter), npm-first installs with same-source anti-squatting checks, update detection, and five agent tools for headless use.
